Star Wars Zero Company Gameplay | Strategist vs. Wildcard
Join gamer and streamer Luality as she takes on Star Wars Zero Company with two very different approaches. After a spin of the wheel determines her playstyle, she builds a squad and tackles the mission as both a by-the-books strategist and an unpredictable wildcard, showcasing the different ways players can approach combat and squad-building.

Star Wars Zero Company is a single-player turn-based tactics game set during the Clone Wars, where players command a customizable squad through an original Star Wars story.

Available now on PC, PlayStation® 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
